import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 5500;
    static final int MAX_M = 35500;
    static final int INF = 0x3B9ACA00;

    static class Edge {
        int next, target, capacity, cost;
        Edge(int next, int target, int capacity, int cost) {
            this.next = next;
            this.target = target;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge> edgeList = new ArrayList<>(MAX_M + 5);
    static List<Integer> adjacencyList = new ArrayList<>(MAX_N + 5);
    static int edgeCounter = 1;

    static void insertEdge(int source, int dest, int cap, int cost) {
        edgeList.add(new Edge(adjacencyList.get(source), dest, cap, cost));
        adjacencyList.set(source, edgeCounter);
        edgeCounter++;
        
        edgeList.add(new Edge(adjacencyList.get(dest), source, 0, -cost));
        adjacencyList.set(dest, edgeCounter);
        edgeCounter++;
    }

    static int src, dst;
    static int[] prevNode = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] edgeUsed = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] minFlow = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] distNode = new int[MAX_N];
    static boolean[] inBfs = new boolean[MAX_N];
    static Queue<Integer> bfsQueue = new LinkedList<>();

    static int spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(distNode, 1, dst + 1, INF);
        Arrays.fill(minFlow, 1, dst + 1, 0);
        minFlow[src] = INF;
        distNode[src] = 0;
        bfsQueue.offer(src);
        inBfs[src] = true;

        while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = bfsQueue.poll();
            inBfs[cur] = false;

            for (int idx = adjacencyList.get(cur); idx != 0; idx = edgeList.get(idx - 1).next) {
                Edge e = edgeList.get(idx - 1);
                if (e.capacity > 0 && distNode[e.target] > distNode[cur] + e.cost) {
                    distNode[e.target] = distNode[cur] + e.cost;
                    minFlow[e.target] = Math.min(minFlow[cur], e.capacity);
                    edgeUsed[e.target] = idx;
                    prevNode[e.target] = cur;
                    if (!inBfs[e.target]) {
                        inBfs[e.target] = true;
                        bfsQueue.offer(e.target);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return minFlow[dst];
    }

    static int N, M, K, COST_BASE, COST_DIST;
    static int[][] plan = new int[105][105];
    static int[][] state = new int[105][105];
    static class Path {
        int start, end;
        Path(int start, int end) {
            this.start = start;
            this.end = end;
        }
    }
    static Path[] paths = new Path[105];

    static int NODE_ID(int r, int c) {
        return r * N + c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        M = sc.nextInt();
        K = sc.nextInt();
        COST_BASE = sc.nextInt();
        COST_DIST = sc.nextInt();

        // Initialize adjacency list
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_N; i++) {
            adjacencyList.add(0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_M; i++) {
            edgeList.add(new Edge(0, 0, 0, 0));
        }

        src = NODE_ID(N + K, N) + 1;
        dst = src + 2;

        insertEdge(NODE_ID(0, 1), dst, INF, 0);

        for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
            int tmp = sc.nextInt();
            insertEdge(src, NODE_ID(0, tmp), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= M / 2; i++) {
            int start = sc.nextInt();
            int end = sc.nextInt();
            paths[i * 2] = new Path(start, end);
            paths[i * 2 - 1] = new Path(end, start);
        }
        M *= 2;

        for (int day = 1; day <= N + K; day++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                insertEdge(NODE_ID(day - 1, j), NODE_ID(day, j), INF, 0);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= M; j++) {
                insertEdge(NODE_ID(day - 1, paths[j].start), NODE_ID(day, paths[j].end), 1, COST_DIST);
                plan[day][j] = edgeCounter;
                state[day][j] = 1;
            }
            insertEdge(NODE_ID(day, 1), dst, INF, day * COST_BASE);
        }

        int augmentVal, ans = 0;
        while ((augmentVal = spfa()) > 0) {
            int node = dst;
            while (node != src) {
                int prev = prevNode[node];
                edgeList.get(edgeUsed[node] - 1).capacity -= augmentVal;
                edgeList.get(edgeUsed[node] ^ 1).capacity += augmentVal;
                node = prev;
            }
            ans += distNode[dst] * augmentVal;

            for (int day = 1; day <= N + N; day++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= M; j++) {
                    if (edgeList.get(plan[day][j] - 1).capacity > 0) {
                        state[day][j]++;
                        insertEdge(NODE_ID(day - 1, paths[j].start), NODE_ID(day, paths[j].end), 1, COST_DIST * (state[day][j] * 2 - 1));
                        plan[day][j] = edgeCounter;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
